update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.19 - Upstream sync: smarter training decisions
Added ----- - Rainbow trainings are now detected from the glowing ring around support cards instead of orange relationship bars, eliminating false rainbows from maxed supports that are not glowing. A new Rainbow Detection debug test helps calibrate it. - The bot now reads your owned skills from the Details screen and shows them as colored pills in the log viewer, along with an estimated overall rank. - Optional "Prefer Training on G1 Days" setting: stay and train when a strong rainbow training is available instead of taking the G1 race.
Changed ----- - Train-or-rest is now decided from all five facilities instead of the Speed facility alone, and a new expected-value gate skips poor-value trainings. - Mandatory career goals (fans, trophies, goal points) now outrank pre-summer prep, and skill hints are checked for failure chance before being tapped. - Unity Cup burst/fill scoring rebalanced with tunable constants; Trackblazer now skips mood recovery at Normal mood by default and its consecutive-races default dropped from 5 to 3.
Fixed ----- - Aptitude letters E and D no longer misread as B. - Stats above the cap are no longer discarded when read from the Details dialog.
